statement: Usage bien établi : médicament à base de plante pour le soulagement des douleurs musculaires, par exemple les lombalgies.

source.title: European Union herbal monograph on Capsicum annuum L. var. minimum (Miller) Heiser and small fruited varieties of Capsicum frutescens L., fructus (EMA/HMPC/674139/2013)
source.quote: Herbal medicinal product for the relief of muscle pain such as low back pain.

statement: Adultes et personnes âgées, emplâtre médicamenteux de 22 x 14 cm : contient 11 mg de capsaïcinoïdes exprimés en capsaïcine (soit 35 µg/cm²).

source.title: European Union herbal monograph on Capsicum annuum L. var. minimum (Miller) Heiser and small fruited varieties of Capsicum frutescens L., fructus (EMA/HMPC/674139/2013)
source.quote: 1 medicated plaster (22 x 14 cm) containing soft extract of Capsici fructus, corresponding to 11 mg capsaicinoids expressed as capsaicin

statement: Adultes et personnes âgées, emplâtre médicamenteux de 12 x 18 cm : contient 4,8 mg de capsaïcinoïdes exprimés en capsaïcine (soit 22 µg/cm²).

source.title: European Union herbal monograph on Capsicum annuum L. var. minimum (Miller) Heiser and small fruited varieties of Capsicum frutescens L., fructus (EMA/HMPC/674139/2013)
source.quote: 1 medicated plaster (12 x 18 cm) containing soft extract of Capsici fructus, corresponding to 4.8 mg capsaicinoids expressed as capsaicin

statement: Dose quotidienne : 1 emplâtre au maximum par jour, appliqué sur la zone concernée pendant au moins 4 heures et jusqu'à 12 heures.

source.title: European Union herbal monograph on Capsicum annuum L. var. minimum (Miller) Heiser and small fruited varieties of Capsicum frutescens L., fructus (EMA/HMPC/674139/2013)
source.quote: A maximum of 1 plaster per day should be applied on the affected area for at least 4 and up to 12 hours.

statement: Un intervalle d'au moins 12 heures doit être respecté avant d'appliquer un nouvel emplâtre sur la même zone.

source.title: European Union herbal monograph on Capsicum annuum L. var. minimum (Miller) Heiser and small fruited varieties of Capsicum frutescens L., fructus (EMA/HMPC/674139/2013)
source.quote: There should be an interval of at least 12 hours before a new plaster is applied at the same application area.

statement: Formes semi-solides, adultes et personnes âgées : correspondant à 40 à 53 mg de capsaïcinoïdes / 100 g.

source.title: European Union herbal monograph on Capsicum annuum L. var. minimum (Miller) Heiser and small fruited varieties of Capsicum frutescens L., fructus (EMA/HMPC/674139/2013)
source.quote: Semi-solid dosage forms corresponding to 40-53 mg capsaicinoids / 100 g.

statement: Formes semi-solides : appliquer en couche fine sur la zone concernée, 2 à 4 fois par jour.

source.title: European Union herbal monograph on Capsicum annuum L. var. minimum (Miller) Heiser and small fruited varieties of Capsicum frutescens L., fructus (EMA/HMPC/674139/2013)
source.quote: To be applied in a thin layer on the affected area 2-4 times daily.

statement: Non recommandé chez les enfants et adolescents de moins de 18 ans (posologie).

source.title: European Union herbal monograph on Capsicum annuum L. var. minimum (Miller) Heiser and small fruited varieties of Capsicum frutescens L., fructus (EMA/HMPC/674139/2013)
source.quote: The use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age is not recommended

statement: Si les symptômes persistent pendant l'utilisation, consulter un médecin ou un pharmacien.

source.title: European Union herbal monograph on Capsicum annuum L. var. minimum (Miller) Heiser and small fruited varieties of Capsicum frutescens L., fructus (EMA/HMPC/674139/2013)
source.quote: If the symptoms persist during the use of the medicinal product, a doctor or a pharmacist should be consulted.

statement: Poursuivre le traitement jusqu'au soulagement de la douleur, si nécessaire pendant 3 semaines au maximum. Après 3 semaines d'utilisation, une pause d'au moins 2 semaines est requise.

source.title: European Union herbal monograph on Capsicum annuum L. var. minimum (Miller) Heiser and small fruited varieties of Capsicum frutescens L., fructus (EMA/HMPC/674139/2013)
source.quote: The medication should be continued until relief of pain is achieved, if necessary up to 3 weeks. After 3 weeks of use a break of at least 2 weeks is required.

statement: Voie d'administration : cutanée uniquement.

source.title: European Union herbal monograph on Capsicum annuum L. var. minimum (Miller) Heiser and small fruited varieties of Capsicum frutescens L., fructus (EMA/HMPC/674139/2013)
source.quote: Cutaneous use.

statement: Se laver les mains à l'eau et au savon après avoir touché ou manipulé l'emplâtre ou la forme semi-solide.

source.title: European Union herbal monograph on Capsicum annuum L. var. minimum (Miller) Heiser and small fruited varieties of Capsicum frutescens L., fructus (EMA/HMPC/674139/2013)
source.quote: Hands should be washed with soap and water after touching or handling the plaster/semisolid dosage form.

statement: Contre-indiquée en cas d'hypersensibilité à la substance active ou à d'autres sources de capsaïcinoïdes (par ex. plants de piment ou piments).

source.title: European Union herbal monograph on Capsicum annuum L. var. minimum (Miller) Heiser and small fruited varieties of Capsicum frutescens L., fructus (EMA/HMPC/674139/2013)
source.quote: Hypersensitivity to the active substance or to other sources of capsaicinoids (e.g. pepper plants or chili).

statement: Contre-indiquée sur peau lésée, plaies et eczéma.

source.title: European Union herbal monograph on Capsicum annuum L. var. minimum (Miller) Heiser and small fruited varieties of Capsicum frutescens L., fructus (EMA/HMPC/674139/2013)
source.quote: Broken skin, wounds and eczema.

statement: Sécurité et efficacité non établies chez les moins de 18 ans, faute de données.

source.title: European Union herbal monograph on Capsicum annuum L. var. minimum (Miller) Heiser and small fruited varieties of Capsicum frutescens L., fructus (EMA/HMPC/674139/2013)
source.quote: The use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age has not been established due to lack of data on safety and efficacy.

statement: Aucune donnée n'est disponible sur l'utilisation chez la femme enceinte.

source.title: European Union herbal monograph on Capsicum annuum L. var. minimum (Miller) Heiser and small fruited varieties of Capsicum frutescens L., fructus (EMA/HMPC/674139/2013)
source.quote: There are no data from the use in pregnant women.

statement: L'emplâtre ou la forme semi-solide ne doit être utilisé pendant la grossesse et l'allaitement qu'après une évaluation attentive du rapport bénéfice/risque.

source.title: European Union herbal monograph on Capsicum annuum L. var. minimum (Miller) Heiser and small fruited varieties of Capsicum frutescens L., fructus (EMA/HMPC/674139/2013)
source.quote: the plaster/semi-solid dosage form should only be used during pregnancy and lactation after a careful risk-benefit assessment.

statement: La capsaïcine traverse le placenta et peut passer dans le lait maternel.

source.title: European Union herbal monograph on Capsicum annuum L. var. minimum (Miller) Heiser and small fruited varieties of Capsicum frutescens L., fructus (EMA/HMPC/674139/2013)
source.quote: Capsaicin crosses the placenta and may pass into breast milk.

statement: Des études animales ont montré une toxicité pour la reproduction après des doses sous-cutanées élevées de capsaïcine.

source.title: European Union herbal monograph on Capsicum annuum L. var. minimum (Miller) Heiser and small fruited varieties of Capsicum frutescens L., fructus (EMA/HMPC/674139/2013)
source.quote: Animal studies have shown reproductive toxicity after high subcutaneous doses of capsaicin.

statement: Aucune donnée sur la fertilité n'est disponible.

source.title: European Union herbal monograph on Capsicum annuum L. var. minimum (Miller) Heiser and small fruited varieties of Capsicum frutescens L., fructus (EMA/HMPC/674139/2013)
source.quote: No fertility data available.

statement: Sans objet selon la monographie (effet sur la conduite et l'utilisation de machines).

source.title: European Union herbal monograph on Capsicum annuum L. var. minimum (Miller) Heiser and small fruited varieties of Capsicum frutescens L., fructus (EMA/HMPC/674139/2013)
source.quote: Not relevant.

statement: Aucune étude d'interaction n'a été réalisée.

source.title: European Union herbal monograph on Capsicum annuum L. var. minimum (Miller) Heiser and small fruited varieties of Capsicum frutescens L., fructus (EMA/HMPC/674139/2013)
source.quote: No interaction studies have been performed.

statement: L'emplâtre ou la forme semi-solide ne doit pas être appliqué en même temps que d'autres produits topiques sur le même site d'application.

source.title: European Union herbal monograph on Capsicum annuum L. var. minimum (Miller) Heiser and small fruited varieties of Capsicum frutescens L., fructus (EMA/HMPC/674139/2013)
source.quote: The plaster/semisolid dosage form is not intended to be applied at the same time as other topical products

statement: Des interactions avec d'autres produits appliqués sur le même site peuvent même survenir jusqu'à 12 heures après le retrait de l'emplâtre.

source.title: European Union herbal monograph on Capsicum annuum L. var. minimum (Miller) Heiser and small fruited varieties of Capsicum frutescens L., fructus (EMA/HMPC/674139/2013)
source.quote: Interactions with other products applied at the same application site may even occur up to 12 hours after the plaster has been removed.

statement: Ne pas appliquer près des yeux ni sur les muqueuses.

source.title: European Union herbal monograph on Capsicum annuum L. var. minimum (Miller) Heiser and small fruited varieties of Capsicum frutescens L., fructus (EMA/HMPC/674139/2013)
source.quote: The medicinal product should not be applied near the eyes or to mucous membranes.

statement: Il est recommandé de ne pas gratter le site d'application, afin d'éviter d'endommager la peau.

source.title: European Union herbal monograph on Capsicum annuum L. var. minimum (Miller) Heiser and small fruited varieties of Capsicum frutescens L., fructus (EMA/HMPC/674139/2013)
source.quote: It is recommended not to scratch the application site to avoid damage to the skin.

statement: Éviter toute source de chaleur supplémentaire pendant le traitement (par ex. rayonnement solaire ou infrarouge, coussin chauffant ou eau chaude).

source.title: European Union herbal monograph on Capsicum annuum L. var. minimum (Miller) Heiser and small fruited varieties of Capsicum frutescens L., fructus (EMA/HMPC/674139/2013)
source.quote: Application of additional sources of heat during treatment should be avoided (e.g. solar or infrared radiation, heating pad or warm water).

statement: L'effet de chaleur peut aussi être intensifié par l'activité physique (transpiration).

source.title: European Union herbal monograph on Capsicum annuum L. var. minimum (Miller) Heiser and small fruited varieties of Capsicum frutescens L., fructus (EMA/HMPC/674139/2013)
source.quote: The effect of warmth can also be intensified by physical activity (sweating).

statement: Arrêter le traitement si l'effet de chaleur est jugé excessif ; retirer alors l'emplâtre ou l'excédent de forme semi-solide.

source.title: European Union herbal monograph on Capsicum annuum L. var. minimum (Miller) Heiser and small fruited varieties of Capsicum frutescens L., fructus (EMA/HMPC/674139/2013)
source.quote: Treatment should be discontinued if the heat effect is experienced as excessive. In this case the plaster or the surplus of the semi-solid dosage form should be removed.

statement: Si les symptômes s'aggravent pendant l'utilisation, consulter un médecin ou un pharmacien.

source.title: European Union herbal monograph on Capsicum annuum L. var. minimum (Miller) Heiser and small fruited varieties of Capsicum frutescens L., fructus (EMA/HMPC/674139/2013)
source.quote: If the symptoms worsen during the use of the medicinal product, a doctor or a pharmacist should be consulted.

statement: Cette réaction fait partie de l'action pharmacologique normale du produit et disparaît en général peu de temps après le retrait de l'emplâtre.

source.title: European Union herbal monograph on Capsicum annuum L. var. minimum (Miller) Heiser and small fruited varieties of Capsicum frutescens L., fructus (EMA/HMPC/674139/2013)
source.quote: This reaction is part of the normal pharmacological action of the preparation and subsides as a rule within a short time after removal of the plaster.

statement: Rarement (~1/10 000 à <1/1 000) : réactions d'hypersensibilité cutanée et allergiques (par ex. urticaire, cloques ou vésiculation au site d'application) peuvent survenir.

source.title: European Union herbal monograph on Capsicum annuum L. var. minimum (Miller) Heiser and small fruited varieties of Capsicum frutescens L., fructus (EMA/HMPC/674139/2013)
source.quote: In rare cases (~1/10,000 to <1/1,000): Skin hypersensitivity and allergic reactions (e.g. urticaria, blisters or vesiculation at the application site) may occur.

statement: En cas de réaction d'hypersensibilité, arrêter le traitement immédiatement.

source.title: European Union herbal monograph on Capsicum annuum L. var. minimum (Miller) Heiser and small fruited varieties of Capsicum frutescens L., fructus (EMA/HMPC/674139/2013)
source.quote: The treatment is to be stopped in such cases immediately.

statement: Surtout pendant les premiers jours de traitement, une sensation de brûlure, de picotement ou de démangeaison peut survenir.

source.title: European Union herbal monograph on Capsicum annuum L. var. minimum (Miller) Heiser and small fruited varieties of Capsicum frutescens L., fructus (EMA/HMPC/674139/2013)
source.quote: Especially during the first days of treatment a burning sensation or stinging or itching may occur.

statement: Si, dans certains cas, les effets indésirables sont jugés excessifs, le traitement doit être arrêté.

source.title: European Union herbal monograph on Capsicum annuum L. var. minimum (Miller) Heiser and small fruited varieties of Capsicum frutescens L., fructus (EMA/HMPC/674139/2013)
source.quote: If, in individual cases, the side effects are experienced as excessive, treatment should be discontinued.

statement: Aucun cas de surdosage n'a été signalé.

source.title: European Union herbal monograph on Capsicum annuum L. var. minimum (Miller) Heiser and small fruited varieties of Capsicum frutescens L., fructus (EMA/HMPC/674139/2013)
source.quote: No case of overdose has been reported.
